# 書齋夜話

**Custom ID:** ZB3j0132

## Authors / Editors
- 俞琰 (宋朝) 撰 1258 - 1314

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 4-*juàn* late-Southern-Sòng / Yuán *bǐjì* by [俞琰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BF%9E%E7%90%B0) (Yú Yǎn), the great *Yì jīng* / *Cāntóngqì* synthesist. The book represents Yú's *suí bǐ* (random-pen) reading-notes from his Sòng-loyalist seclusion at Línwūshān. The first *juàn* is classical exegesis (focused on *Lùn yǔ*, *Mèng zǐ*, and the *Wǔ jīng*); the second and third extend the various Confucian masters' sayings, with substantial coverage of the *Hé tú* / *Luò shū* and the *Xiān tiān tài jí èr tú* — the central concerns of Yú's *Yì*-scholarship; the fourth is on literary-and-prose composition. Yú's *Yì*-school affiliation is with [陳摶](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B3%E6%91%B6) (Chén Tuán) and the inner-alchemy tradition — his *Cāntóngqì fāhuī* ([KR5a1005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a1005)) being the principal late-Sòng / Yuán authority on the *Zhōu yì cāntóng qì* — and the book accordingly draws Daoist material into Confucian-classical exegesis. The *Sìkù* editors regard the book as primarily an *Yì*-exegesis work and acknowledge Yú's literary-prose strengths as inferior to his *Yì* strengths.

**Abstract**

The *Shū zhāi yè huà* is one of the principal *bǐjì* of [俞琰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BF%9E%E7%90%B0) (Yú Yǎn) — the consummate late-Sòng / Yuán *Yì jīng* synthesist of the [陳摶](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B3%E6%91%B6) (Chén Tuán) line. The book is structured as a four-fascicle classified *bǐjì*:

1. *Juàn* 1: classical *kǎozhèng* — particularly the refutation of Kǒng Ānguó's "*Luò shū to grant Yǔ*" reading; word-glossing across the classics; the *Lùn yǔ Fù yǔ guì* phrase-ending; the *Mèng zǐ Zé mù shǎo ài* tonal reading.
2. *Juàn* 2–3: *Hé tú* / *Luò shū* and *Xiān tiān* / *Tài jí èr tú* elaborations — central to Yú's *Yì*-scholarship and presented in conjunction with the Daoist material (from his *Cāntóng qì fāhuī* [KR5a1005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a1005) and *Yīn fú jīng zhù* [KR5a0126](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0126)).
3. *Juàn* 4: literary-prose discussion — judged inferior to the *Yì* sections by the *Sìkù* editors.

The book is a significant testament to Yú's lifelong project of integrating *Yì*-divination, inner alchemy, and Sòng Neo-Confucian thought. It is, alongside Yú's [KR1a0064](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0064) *Zhōu yì jí shuō* and [KR1a0065](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0065) *Dú Yì jǔ yào*, the principal vehicle of his transmitted *Yì*-teaching.

Dating. The book belongs to Yú's mature/late period in Sòng-loyalist retreat at Línwūshān. *NotBefore* 1280 / *notAfter* 1314 (his death). The standard text is the SKQS 4-*juàn* recension.
